title: Governing Body - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Governing Body - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The webpage provides contact and basic information for Lady Irwin College in Delhi, noting its affiliation with the University of Delhi. It highlights the college’s A+ accreditation by NAAC and its position at 31 in the NIRF rankings. Admission enquiries are available from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm, and the college’s phone number is listed as 014836. Quick links for students, college timing, and site visitors are included, and the site is powered by WhiteCode.
key_points: Lady Irwin College is located in Delhi and is part of the University of Delhi.
The college holds an A+ accreditation from NAAC.
It ranks 31 in the NIRF rankings.
Admission enquiries can be made between 9:30 am and 5:00 pm.
The contact phone number for the college is 014836.
The website is powered by WhiteCode and includes quick links for students, college timing, and site visitors.
